name: I-539 Extend or Change Nonimmigrant Status
summary: Extension of stay or change of nonimmigrant status (for example B-2 extension, change to F-1), with I-539A for each co-applicant family member.

forms.title: Supplemental Information for Application to Extend/Change Nonimmigrant Status
forms.note: One for each additional person included (I-539 Instructions).

filing.where: See 'Where To File' on uscis.gov/i-539. Many categories can file online.

questions.label: Extension of stay or change of status?
Status requested (for example B-2, F-1, H-4)
Date you want to stay until
Why do you need the extension or change?
Are family members included on this application?
How will you support yourself during the stay?

checklist.label: Front and back of Form I-94 for each person included
Valid passport biographic page for each person
Marriage and birth certificates for included family members
Bank statements or support letter showing you can pay for your stay
Evidence supporting the reason (medical letter, I-20, return ticket, etc.)

coverLetter.re: Form I-539, Application to Extend/Change Nonimmigrant Status - {{requestType}} to {{requestedStatus}}
coverLetter.request: We respectfully submit the enclosed Form I-539 on behalf of {{givenName}} {{familyName}}, requesting {{requestType}} in {{requestedStatus}} status until {{requestedUntil}}.
points: The application is filed before the current authorized stay expires ({{statusExpires}}), or the delay was due to extraordinary circumstances.
The applicant has maintained status and has the means to support the requested stay.
